# Acute Care Simulation Lab

Welcome to the University of Oregon Acute Care Simulation Lab.

Each simulation is designed to mirror the clinical reasoning process used by Speech-Language Pathologists in the acute care setting. Select a simulation below to begin.

::: {.card-grid}

::: {.chart-card}
## 🧠 Simulation 1

### Initial Patient Contact

Acute ischemic stroke with altered mental status requiring an initial Speech-Language Pathology consultation.

Students will complete:

- Case Overview
- Chart Review
- Vital Signs
- Bedside Contact
- Clinical Impression & Recommendations

[Begin Simulation 1](simulations/sim1/index.html)

:::

::: {.chart-card}
## 🩺 Simulation 2

### Oral Mechanism Examination & Dysphagia Practice

Apply cranial nerve knowledge, practice oral mechanism examinations, and explore clinical decision-making in dysphagia assessment.

Students will complete:

- Cranial Nerve Review
- Oral Mechanism Examination Practice
- Simulated Patient Case Studies
- Bedside & Instrumental Assessment Scenarios

[Begin Simulation 2](simulations/sim2/index.html)

:::

::: {.chart-card}
## 🧠 Simulation 3

### Cognitive Screening & Clinical Decision-Making

Evaluate cognitive-communication functioning following a right MCA ischemic stroke through medical chart review, interdisciplinary collaboration, and standardized cognitive screening.

Students will complete:

- Medical Chart Review
- Interdisciplinary Documentation Review
- Cognitive Screening Readiness
- MoCA Administration
- Functional Implications & Recommendations

[Begin Simulation 3](simulations/sim3/index.html)

:::

::: {.chart-card}
## 💬 Simulation 4

### Aphasia Assessment & Clinical Decision-Making

Evaluate language functioning in a patient with a history of left hemisphere stroke and reported changes in communication following a fall.

Students will complete:

- Medical Chart Review
- Interdisciplinary Documentation Review
- Communication Considerations & Assessment Preparation
- Quick Aphasia Battery (QAB) Administration
- Functional Implications & Recommendations

[Begin Simulation 4](simulations/sim4/index.html)

:::

:::
